disclosure: Some booking links on this site are affiliate links. If you book through them we may earn a commission, at no extra cost to you.
_howTo: Paste the tracking link your affiliate network gives you into 'link' (used for every city) or into 'cityLinks' with a country code key, such as "FRA", for a city-specific link. A partner with no link is hidden. 'modes' sets which tabs show the button: train, tram, bus, airport, tips (the Tips & Apps tab, used for eSIM). Route guides use 'routes': paste your tracking link into 'link' for each slot. A slot with no link is hidden.
